executed_source:
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor,as_completed
import requests,json,hashlib,threading,pdfplumber,subprocess,shutil
root=Path.cwd();out=root/'reports/research/510300_treasury_borrowing_revision_panel_v1'
candidates=json.loads((out/'table_candidates.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
assert len(candidates)==16 and all(len(x['links'] or x['images'])==1 for x in candidates)
assert not (out/'table_receipts.json').exists()
entries=[]
for x in candidates:
 e=(x['links'] or x['images'])[0];entries.append({'quarter':x['quarter'],'url':e['url'],'source_label':e['label']})
local=threading.local();throttle=threading.Event()
def fetch(e):
 url=e['url'];suffix='.png' if '.png' in url.lower() else '.pdf'
 p=out/('sources/'+e['quarter']+'_资金来源与用途原表'+suffix)
 rec={**e,'path':str(p.relative_to(root)).replace('\\','/'),'attempts':[]}
 if e['quarter']=='2023Q3':
  original=root/'reports/research/510300_treasury_borrowing_revision_source_qualification_v1/sources/20230731_资金来源与用途原表.pdf'
  p.write_bytes(original.read_bytes());rec.update(status='REUSED_E10_ORIGINAL',bytes=p.stat().st_size,sha256=hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest());return rec
 if throttle.is_set():rec['status']='NOT_REQUESTED_SOURCE_THROTTLE';return rec
 if not hasattr(local,'session'):
  local.session=requests.Session();local.session.headers.update({'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64)'})
 for attempt in range(1,3):
  r=None;a={'attempt':attempt,'requested_at':datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat()}
  try:
   r=local.session.get(url,timeout=(15,35));a['http_status']=r.status_code
   if r.status_code in (403,429):throttle.set()
   r.raise_for_status()
   assert (r.content.startswith(b'%PDF') if suffix=='.pdf' else r.content.startswith(b'\x89PNG'))
   p.write_bytes(r.content);a['status']='SAVED_ORIGINAL';rec['attempts'].append(a)
   rec.update(status='SAVED_ORIGINAL',bytes=len(r.content),sha256=hashlib.sha256(r.content).hexdigest());return rec
  except Exception as err:
   a.update(status='FAILED',error=str(err)[:800]);rec['attempts'].append(a)
   if r is not None and r.status_code in (403,429):break
 rec['status']='FAILED_AFTER_REGISTERED_ATTEMPTS';return rec
receipts=[]
with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=3) as pool:
 for future in as_completed([pool.submit(fetch,e) for e in entries]):receipts.append(future.result())
receipts.sort(key=lambda x:x['quarter'])
(out/'table_receipts.json').write_text(json.dumps({'receipts':receipts,'tls_verify':True},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
render=out/'source_render';render.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
pdf_records=[]
for rec in receipts:
 if rec['status'] not in ['SAVED_ORIGINAL','REUSED_E10_ORIGINAL']:print('原表未取得：',rec['quarter'],rec['status']);continue
 p=root/rec['path']
 if p.suffix.lower()=='.png':
  print(rec['quarter'],'PNG原表：',str(p.resolve()));continue
 with pdfplumber.open(p) as pdf:
  pages=[{'page':n,'text':page.extract_text(layout=False) or ''} for n,page in enumerate(pdf.pages,1)]
  pdf_records.append({'quarter':rec['quarter'],'url':rec['url'],'sha256':rec['sha256'],'pages':pages})
  print(rec['quarter'],'PDF',len(pages),'页；当前区域：',pages[0]['text'][-1800:])
 r=subprocess.run([shutil.which('pdftoppm'),'-r','130','-png',str(p),str(render/(rec['quarter']+'_原页'))],capture_output=True,encoding='utf-8',errors='replace')
 assert r.returncode==0,r.stderr
(out/'所有原PDF页面文字.json').write_text(json.dumps(pdf_records,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
print('原表已取得：',sum(x['status'] in ['SAVED_ORIGINAL','REUSED_E10_ORIGINAL'] for x in receipts),'/16；PDF对象',len(pdf_records),'；渲染页',len(list(render.glob('*.png'))))
